mapper.select:
SELECT m.id, IFNULL(m.title, '') AS title, IFNULL(m.request_user, '') AS request_user, IFNULL(m.description, '') AS description, IFNULL(m.solve, '') AS solve, IFNULL(m.type, '') AS type, DATE_FORMAT(m.request_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS request_date, IFNULL(u.nickname, 'Unknown') AS owner, -- NULL일 경우 기본값 IFNULL(c.name, 'No Customer') AS customerName, IFNULL(ml.customer_id, 0) AS customerId, IFNULL(d.id, 0) AS domainId, IFNULL(d.dep_name, 'No Department') AS domainName FROM maintenance m LEFT JOIN maintenance_list ml ON m.id = ml.maintenance_id LEFT JOIN user u ON ml.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN customer c ON ml.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN department d ON ml.department_id = d.id WHERE 1 = 1
AND m.id = #{id} ;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maintenance(id, request_user, description, title, solve, request_date, type) VALUES(#{id}, #{request_user},#{title}, #{description},#{solve},#{request_date}, #{type});
INSERT INTO maintenance_list(user_id, maintenance_id, customer_id, department_id) VALUES(#{user_id},#{newId},#{customerId},#{domainId});
mapper.update: UPDATE maintenance SET request_user=#{name}, description=#{description},solve=#{solve} WHERE id=#{id};
